about.title: About the project
about.lead: Bookeep is a catalog of adapted books in English and Finnish. There are no lessons or exercises here: you open a book and read it in the browser.

purpose.title: Why it exists
purpose.text: A textbook gives rules and drills. An original novel is often too dense if the language is not yet fluent. Adaptation sits between them: you read a continuous story at a level you can already hold, without a dictionary on every line.

adaptation.title: What an adapted book is
adaptation.text: It is not a short retelling and not a set of dialogues. It is the full work, with denser grammar, rarer words and long periods brought to a chosen CEFR level. Plot, characters and structure stay. What changes first is the language.

languages.title: English and Finnish
languages.text: Books in the catalog are English and Finnish only. Those are the languages of the texts. The interface can be switched to Finnish, English, Ukrainian or Russian: site labels change, the book stays in the language of the adaptation.

levels.title: Levels A2 and B1
levels.text: Each title has a level. A2 is clearer and shorter. B1 sits closer to ordinary fiction, but is still written with a language learner in mind. Take what you can read calmly.

reading.title: How reading works
reading.text: In the catalog you can filter by language and level. The book opens on the site: pages, zoom, light or dark paper. Reading works without an account; the last page stays on this device. Sign in to keep likes, a reading list and history across browsers.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: This page explains what Bookeep stores, what the contact form sends, and how to reach us about personal data.

who.title: Who we are
who.text: Bookeep is a catalog of adapted books run by the WEISEZAHOY studio. For privacy requests write to <mail>{{email}}</mail>.

data.title: What we process
data.text: Theme and language stay on this device. If you sign in, we store your email (and Google name if you use Google), likes, planned books and reading progress in Supabase. Administrators have a separate catalog login. Hosting is on Hostinger; book files and the catalog sit in Supabase storage and database.

account.title: Accounts
account.text: You can create an email account or sign in with Google. Likes, the reading list and history belong to that account. Sign-out does not delete them. To delete an account, write to <mail>{{email}}</mail>.

form.title: Contact form
form.text: If you send the form, we receive your name, email, topic and message. Partnership notes go to partner@weisezahoy.com. Questions and bug reports go to admin@weisezahoy.com. We use them only to reply.

local.title: On this device
local.text: Theme, language and guest reading progress are stored in the browser. After you sign in, progress is also saved to your account. Clearing site data removes the local copy.

sharing.title: Sharing
sharing.text: We do not sell personal data. Messages may pass through the form delivery service to reach our mailboxes. Hosting and database providers process data only to run the site.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask what we hold from a contact message, ask us to delete it, or object to further use. Write to <mail>{{email}}</mail>. We update this page if the way we handle data changes.
